item.title: A message from Prom Committee:
item.description: Bring CASH tomorrow for our all day bake sale outside the gym during EOSSAA! Grab a delicious treat and support your Prom Committee! 🧁🍪

item.title: A message from: Mme Perron.
item.description: There will be a Europe Team meeting tomorrow at lunch in room 125. All travelers must attend.

item.title: A message from Ms. Timmins:
item.description: If you're interested in trying out for the Varsity Girls' Hockey Team this year, there will be an important information meeting tomorrow in Room 219 at the beginning of lunch. Please see Ms. Timmins if you have any questions.

item.title: A message from Mr. Warner:
item.description: The junior girls' basketball team is very excited to host the EOSSAA AA Basketball Championships tomorrow! The girls have been working very hard this season and can't wait to play in front of the best fans in the EOSSAA region. The Ravens play their first game at 1030 so please come out at lunch hour and cheer them on against St. Michael from Kemptville. Their second game is at 1:30 pm against Notre Dame from Carleton Place. Let's get loud Ravens!!

item.title: A message from Guidance:
item.description: Just a quick update that Cambrian College will no longer be presenting during Period 3 today. Instead, Sam, Cambrian College's liaison, will be set up in the main foyer during lunch. All students are welcome to stop by, learn more about Cambrian College, and ask Sam any questions they may have about programs or admissions.
